answer_2.quote: We use common metrics from caption generation: BLEU-4, measuring token overlap up to 4grams ; CIDEr, measuring overlap based on the consensus of reference instructions , METEOR (Banerjee and Lavie, 2005), measuring unigram overlap with advanced normalization like stemming and synonym comparison, and ROUGE-L which measures similarity based on longest common subsequences.
